digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler — peer confirmation from snapshots
propositions: A snapshot entry with issuelinks present and a bound link must produce a peer-confirmation record with direction=snapshot, source=snapshot, link_id from raw entry id, and current pass_id.
A snapshot entry with issuelinks key absent must produce no confirmation record for that issue, even when the link exists locally, because absence is unobserved not evidence.
An authoritative issuelinks: [] must produce no record and must not remove or invalidate existing confirmations, preserving the monotonic additive property.

A link whose source or target key is unbound must be skipped without raising, and inward link relations must be mapped through link_direction into local vocabulary (e.g. Blocks inward becomes depends_on).
Confirmation must be called in reconcile.py _persist_and_log before binding_store.save, wrapped in fail-open exception handling so sync passes complete even if snapshot confirmation raises.
